name: Mountain Crest Acquisition 6 Corp. Units
summary: Mountain Crest Acquisition 6 Corp. functions as a blank check company, specifically a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC). Its core mission is to complete a business combination, which could entail a merger, the acquisition of assets or shares, a corporate reorganization, or another form of strategic integration with one or more existing entities. This firm was established on January 6, 2026, and maintains its principal office in New York, NY.
